title: Flow Cytometry Protocol for Human HER2 Detection Using Anti-HER2 Antibodies
author: abinScience cheng
materials: Do NOT wash. Proceed directly to antibody staining.
Add antibody at recommended concentration: 1–10 μg/mL for unconjugated; per manufacturer's datasheet for conjugated formats.
Incubate at 4°C for 30 minutes, protected from light.
Wash twice with 200 μL FACS buffer, centrifuge at 300 × g for 5 minutes.

Option A — Directly conjugated antibodies (recommended for simplicity): - Anti-Human HER2 Antibody (4D5V8), FITC (Cat# HY286117): https://www.abinscience.com/product/40/4706.html - Anti-Human HER2 Antibody (4D5V8), PE (Cat# HY286127): https://www.abinscience.com/product/40/7727.html - Anti-Human HER2 Antibody (4D5V8), APC (Cat# HY286137): https://www.abinscience.com/product/40/5713.html Option B — Unconjugated antibodies (requires secondary staining): - Anti-Human HER2 Antibody (4D5V8) (Cat# HY286107): https://www.abinscience.com/product/40/3823.html - Anti-Human HER2 Antibody (MAB 2C4) (Cat# HY286207): https://www.abinscience.com/product/40/3824.html - Research Grade Trastuzumab (Cat# HY286016): https://www.abinscience.com/product/71/2222.html 1. Add antibody at recommended concentration: 1–10 μg/mL for unconjugated; per manufacturer's datasheet for conjugated formats. 2. Incubate at 4°C for 30 minutes, protected from light. 3. Wash twice with 200 μL FACS buffer, centrifuge at 300 × g for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Harvest and prepare cells
steps.instruction: Harvest adherent cells with Accutase, wash, resuspend in FACS buffer at 1 × 10⁷ cells/mL, and aliquot 100 µL (1 × 10⁶ cells) per well of a 96‑well V‑bottom plate; include recommended positive (SK‑BR‑3 or BT‑474) and negative (MDA‑MB‑231) controls.

substeps.instruction: Harvest cells; for adherent lines (e.g., SK‑BR‑3, BT‑474) use Accutase to preserve surface antigens.
Wash once with PBS and centrifuge at 300 × g for 5 min.
Resuspend in FACS buffer (PBS + 2 % FBS + 0.05 % sodium azide) at 1 × 10⁷ cells/mL.
Aliquot 100 µL (1 × 10⁶ cells) into each well of a 96‑well V‑bottom plate.

steps.title: Viability dye staining
steps.instruction: Stain cells with viability dye, incubate, wash, and keep on ice.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge at 300 × g for 5 min and discard supernatant.
Resuspend pellet in 100 µL PBS containing viability dye according to the manufacturer’s instructions.
Incubate at room temperature for 15 min protected from light.
Wash once with FACS buffer.

steps.title: Block Fc receptors
steps.instruction: Add Fc block in FACS buffer, incubate at room temperature, and proceed without washing.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend cells in 50 µL FACS buffer containing Fc block (5 µL per test).
Incubate at room temperature for 10 min.
Do NOT wash; proceed directly to antibody staining.

steps.title: Stain with secondary antibody
steps.instruction: Add fluorochrome‑conjugated secondary antibody at recommended dilution, incubate at 4 °C, then wash twice.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend cells in 100 µL FACS buffer containing the fluorochrome‑conjugated secondary antibody at the recommended dilution.
Incubate at 4 °C for 20–30 min protected from light.
Wash twice with FACS buffer.

steps.title: Fix cells
steps.instruction: Fix cells with 2 % paraformaldehyde, wash, and resuspend for acquisition; store at 4 °C protected from light, acquire within 24 h.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend cells in 200 µL 2 % paraformaldehyde in PBS.
Incubate at 4 °C for 15 min.
Wash once with FACS buffer.
Resuspend in 200 µL FACS buffer for acquisition.
Fixed samples can be stored at 4 °C protected from light and acquired within 24 h.

steps.title: Acquire and analyze data
steps.instruction: Collect ≥10 000 live events on flow cytometer, apply FSC/SSC → singlet → viable → HER2+ gating, include isotype/FMO controls, and compare to expected HER2 positivity.

substeps.instruction: Acquire ≥10 000 events in the live cell gate on a flow cytometer.
Apply gating strategy: FSC/SSC → singlets (FSC‑A vs FSC‑H) → viable cells → HER2+ population.
Include isotype control or FMO control to set the positive gate.
Expected results: SK‑BR‑3 >95 % HER2‑positive; MDA‑MB‑231 <5 % HER2‑positive.
